name: work-design
description: Sixteen skills for the moments when the quality of a piece of work is decided, in any field. Start: plan-the-work (one-page Work Card), fit-to-deadline, how-long-will-it-take, scope-the-work, what-could-go-wrong. Middle: get-unstuck, delegate, meeting-or-message, continue-in-new-chat, cut-token-cost. End: review-my-work, lessons-learned. Tools: before-you-install, audit-my-tools, before-you-switch. Say work-design if unsure which. Each ends on a plan, verdict or template and runs with no setup.
